source_text: De transitu Iordanis. Peccatori omnis creatura hostis est, sicut de Aegyptiis: terra fluvium aer caelum impugnabant. Iusto etiam inaccessibilia plana fiunt. Mare rubrum iustus per aridam transit; Aegyptius submergitur. In eremo cibus e caelis. In Iordane arca Testamenti dux; ordo sacerdotalis consistit; aquae cursum refrenant. Tibi Christiano per baptismi sacramentum Iordanis fluenta digressus, Paulus maiora promittit: Rapiemur in nubibus obviam Christo in aera. Si transeas per ignem, flamma non aduret te. Omnis creatura iusto famulatur — et in te mystice complentur.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning crossing of-Jordan. To-sinner every creature enemy is, as concerning Egyptians: earth river air heaven were-assailing. To-just even inaccessible-things level become. Sea red just-man through dry crosses; Egyptian is-sunk. In desert food from heavens. In Jordan ark of-Testament leader; order priestly stands; waters course restrain. To-you Christian through of-baptism sacrament of-Jordan streams having-passed, Paul greater-things promises: We-shall-be-seized in clouds to-meet Christ into air. If you-cross through fire, flame not will-burn you. Every creature to-just serves — and in you mystically are-fulfilled.
pass_b_english: On the crossing of the Jordan. To the sinner every creature is an enemy, as with the Egyptians — earth, river, air, and heaven fought them. For the just even impassable things are made level. The just crosses the Red Sea as on dry ground; the Egyptian sinks. In the desert food is served from heaven. At the Jordan the ark of the covenant leads; the priestly order stands; the waters check their course. You, Christian, who have passed Jordan’s streams in baptism’s sacrament, hear Paul promise still greater things: [[We shall be caught up in the clouds to meet Christ in the air >> Bible:1 Thessalonians 4:17]]. [[If you pass through fire, the flame will not burn you >> Bible:Isaiah 43:2]]. Every creature serves the just — and these things are fulfilled mystically in you.
